name: Ironband's Progress Report
summary: In eastern Loch Modan, troggs have brought Prospector Ironband's excavation to a halt. His report asks for more blastpowder, though the Explorers' League sent supplies weeks ago.

sections.title: A Plea for Gunpowder
sections.body: Jern Hornhelm receives the dispatch in Thelsamar and forwards it to the Explorers' League in Ironforge. Ironband reports that work has stalled and asks for heavy munitions. The League leaders are baffled. They sent him plenty of blastpowder weeks ago, and now wonder where it went.

faq.answer: Prospector Ironband's report describes troggs disrupting his excavation in Loch Modan and asks for more blastpowder.

aliases: who do i give the report to
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm receives the report in Thelsamar, then sends it to Prospector Stormpike at the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Ironband need more blastpowder?
faq.answer: Ironband says he needs blastpowder for his digging, though nearby trogg raids may also make explosives useful for defense. Hornhelm and Stormpike believe they sent him plenty weeks ago.

faq.q: How does Prospector Stormpike react to the report?
faq.answer: Prospector Stormpike is furious that work has advanced so slowly. He is baffled that Ironband does not mention the large shipment sent earlier, and wonders where the missing blastpowder went.

angles.text: As a dwarf who explores or mines, you know the dangers of excavating ancient titan sites in Khaz Modan.
As a miner, you know blastpowder can clear stubborn rock. You also know how dangerous it is when supplies go missing in trogg territory.
